validation_scope: Counterfactual do(mask_assumption h) audit over Phase 3 graph-action predictions. Masks remove relation-node, family-overlap, role-schema, or invariant-trace support and measure prediction/utility changes.

mask_specs.description: Remove the candidate alignment relation and all direct overlap evidence.
Remove shared family tags while retaining any role-schema support.
Remove shared perturbation/response/constraint roles while retaining family support.
Keep endpoints but damp the invariant and textual trace contribution.

interpretation: The relation-node deletion acts like the environment removing a candidate assumption edge.  If the positive action's predicted utility drops while negative controls remain screened, the system has a measurable internal contribution signal for that assumption.  This remains a pipeline counterfactual, not a mathematical or physical causality proof.
